entries.zh: 頭：事物之开端、起头；兼指头、首
entries.en: head; beginning of anything, first part (of a thing or affair)
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；语义依L/H/M三栏互证（頭于事为起头、开端）

entries.zh: 序：次序、开端；序言、叙文
entries.en: order, sequence; beginning, opening; preface

entries.zh: 始：开端、开始；起始
entries.en: beginning; to begin, to start
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；字义四栏相合（始＝开端），仅声调栏不可辨

entries.zh: 倡：倡始、首倡，首先发起；R栏注「例之开端」，M栏例句残缺
entries.en: to initiate, to lead the way, to be the first; beginning of an example (compiler's note; Hokkien example phrase damaged)
entries.notes: M栏例句[残]且含[疑]，声调T99；释义依L/H与R栏注（principio de exemplo）取「首倡」义

entries.zh: 創：创立、创始；开创、创建（M栏兼注「建立」一语）
entries.en: to create, to originate, to found; to establish, to set up
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；M栏'chong lip. gien lip.'当为「创立、建立」二词，与H「創」相合

entries.zh: 雜：混杂、杂乱；西栏释「万物之始」，字义不合，存疑
entries.en: mixed, miscellaneous; the Spanish gloss 'beginning of things' does not fit this character - entry uncertain
entries.notes: 「雜」无「开端」义且与M栏音vo不合，对应关系无法定夺；声调T99

entries.zh: 巔：山顶、巅顶；顶端（西栏释「万物之始」，义不合，存疑）
entries.en: summit, peak, top; the Spanish gloss 'beginning of things' does not fit this character - entry uncertain
entries.notes: 「巔」（顶端）与西栏「开端」义不合，M栏音fien与字音亦不谐，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 腎：肾；旧说肾藏精、为生育之本（西栏释「腹中之精始」，R栏注此字宜再考）
entries.en: kidney; taken as the seminal principle in the womb, seat of generation (compiler's note: examine the word further)
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；R栏注'examina mas el vocablo'（宜再考），释义依「肾藏精、主生育」旧说与西栏相合

entries.zh: 漢：天河、银汉；亦指汉子、汉人（西栏释「天地之始」，义不合，存疑）
entries.en: Milky Way; Han Chinese, man; the Spanish gloss 'beginning of the world' does not fit - entry uncertain
entries.notes: 「漢」与西栏「天地之始」义不合（或取天汉、汉土之义），对应无法定夺；声调T99

entries.zh: 本：根本、本源；事物的根基、根柢
entries.en: root; origin, source; foundation, basis

entries.zh: 初：起初、开端；当初（西栏兼「在起初」义）
entries.en: beginning; at first, at the outset
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；字义四栏相合（初＝起初）

entries.zh: 原：本原、起源；原由
entries.en: origin, source; original cause

entries.zh: 建：建立、创立；兴作开端
entries.en: to establish, to found; to make a beginning of something

entries.zh: 起頭：起头；开始着手做某事
entries.en: to begin something, to set about something; beginning
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；M栏'tau, quy tau'即「頭、起頭」，与H「起頭」相合

entries.zh: 佐起頭（疑为「做起頭」之讹）：起头去做、开始做某事
entries.en: to begin doing something, to make a start (headword character reads 'assist', likely a slip for 'do')
entries.notes: H「佐起頭」疑为「做起頭」形讹（M栏音cho两通），依西栏'començar algo'取「开始做」义；声调T99

entries.zh: 初頭：起初、开头
entries.en: beginning, the start
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；字义四栏相合（初頭＝起初、开头）

entries.zh: 興工：动工、开工（工程之始）
entries.en: to begin work, to commence construction
entries.notes: L栏[残]且M栏声调T99；释义依H「興工」与M'hin cang'（兴工）取「动工、开工」义

entries.zh: 根源：根源、本源
entries.en: root and origin, source
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；M栏'gun; quin guan'即「根、根源」，与H合

entries.zh: 根本：根本、根柢；事物之本
entries.en: root, foundation, basis
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；M栏'gun; quin pun'即「根、本」，与H合

entries.zh: 根因：根本原因、缘由之根
entries.en: root cause, underlying cause
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；字义四栏相合（根因＝根本原因）

entries.zh: 本源：本源、根源
entries.en: origin, source, fountainhead
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；字义四栏相合（本源＝根源）

entries.zh: 起初：起初、当初、一开始
entries.en: at first, at the beginning, initially
entries.notes: M栏声调T99污損；M栏两读含初、起诸音，与H「起初」相合
